scripts.prebuild: bun run --filter @velvet/contracts build && bun run scripts/subset-icon-font.ts
scripts.preconfigurator:build: bun run --filter @velvet/contracts build && bun run scripts/subset-icon-font.ts
scripts.preonboarding:build: bun run --filter @velvet/contracts build && bun run scripts/subset-icon-font.ts
scripts.prewebsite:build: bun run --filter @velvet/contracts build && bun run scripts/subset-icon-font.ts
scripts.website:build: svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && vite build --config vite.website.ts && bun run references:build && bun run changelog:build && bun run documentation:build && bun run man-pages:build
scripts.pretest: bun run --filter @velvet/contracts build && bun run scripts/subset-icon-font.ts
scripts.test: bun run test:units && bun run test:browser && bun run test:builds
scripts.test:browser: for file in test/*browser*.test.ts; do bun test "$file" || exit 1; done
